name: Amber International Holding Limited American Depositary Shares
summary: Amber International Holding Ltd. functions as a real estate enterprise, engaged in both the creation and funding of hospitality ventures. The company strategically focuses its efforts on nascent and less-developed global markets. It designs and constructs distinctive resort properties, ensuring they harmoniously integrate indigenous characteristics and capitalize on local tourism prospects. For day-to-day operations and supervision, Amber International establishes partnerships with professional management entities.
